verbatim.method: exact text extracted from the session transcript

owner_decision_summary.architecture: FROZEN as of 2026-10-08: atmospheric intake -> active compressor / plenum / feed -> Hall thruster -> 13.56 MHz RF/ICP neutralizer -> thrust; atmospheric species primary propellant; Xe contingency / commissioning / emergency only; electromagnetic Hall field; H1 reference geometry; 1,350 W design allocation and < 1,500 W RFP ceiling; <= 34 kg nominal dry; 2 kg reference Xe. The propulsion architecture trade is not reopened; no alternative architectures unless a demonstrated architecture-level impossibility.
owner_decision_summary.freeze_boundary: DBF-1 is the controlled baseline; a physical change names the DBF-1 item, the quantitative reason, goes through a formal DCR, preserves immutable history, and preregisters the evaluation method before comparing replacements
priorities: P1 intake / compressor redesign under DCR (whole governed state / scenario set)
P2 Hall RP-1 numerical convergence, then the Hall envelope for M2
P3 H1-specific B(z) (FEMM-derived, then measured), surrogate kept separate
P4 RF/ICP neutralizer closure incl. AIR / Xe rate sets, I_e,cap, neutralization margin; finish the AIR omitted-process audit
P5 mass closure after redesign (<= 34.0 kg dry, < 40 kg wet at 2 kg Xe, 10 % margin)
P6 power ledger closure (all TBD terms; nominal, 12 mN, 25 mN, worst state, Xe points)
P7 thermal closure on the frozen topology (hot / cold cases)
P8 materials evidence gates for the retained selections
P9 host-drag interface: allowable C_D*A envelope vs state for the spacecraft team as an ICD constraint
owner_decision_summary.sequence: critical path: Hall RP-1 convergence + intake / compressor DCR + AIR chemistry / ICP closure -> mass + power + thermal -> M2 rerun on the revised controlled baseline -> M3 final architecture closure decision
owner_decision_summary.documentation: for every open item maintain (A) engineering evidence and (B) a submission-safe statement; controlled wording; no unnecessary TBD / TBC

recorder_notes: This decision lifts the CLAUDE.md phase rule 'No RFP document work in this phase unless the owner asks' for the submission-safe statements and documentation readiness it requests; the frozen bid records (technical source 5eee4b8, package 2de86ab) remain immutable evidence.
